tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground, the track line and the white half of the stopwatch bezel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on surface and on dial-yellow; chequer black.

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Top of the sky gradient; white text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: sky-light
tokens.usage: Horizon end of the sky gradient. Use ink text on it.

tokens.name: dial-navy
tokens.usage: Stopwatch face and dark panels behind the countdown; white text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: stopwatch-orange
tokens.usage: Crown buttons, bezel arc and the COUNTDOWN word. White on it only at 24px+.

tokens.name: dial-yellow
tokens.usage: The DAYS label and the end of the bezel arc; ink text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: kerb-red
tokens.usage: Red of the red-and-white kerb and the car's nose stripe.

tokens.name: grass-green
tokens.usage: Hills and grass in the scene.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; chequer pitch on the cover.
